arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/security.md'
s=open(p).read()
a="GitHub masks registered secrets in the log, but not in the refs."
assert a in s
s=s.replace(a,a+" pi-action stops the runner from running workflow commands (such as `::error::` or `::add-mask::`) in the text of pi and in the output of tools.")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npx oxfmt --check >/dev/null && echo fmt-ok
git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
fix: don't run workflow commands from tool output, and log only new requests

Found in the first real run of the new log (run 43188744510 on #46):

- Tool output with `::error file=...::` lines (oxlint's GitHub reporter)
  was printed as is, so the runner made failure annotations on the run.
  Text from pi and tools now goes between ::stop-commands:: markers when it
  has a line that looks like a workflow command.
- A run resubmits every trigger on the thread, so it logged a `▶ Request`
  line for each request earlier runs had answered (five on #46). The line
  now comes from a `started` callback, called only for submissions that
  are not settled yet.
- A tool call's arguments are shown as `key: value`, with multi-line
  strings (scripts, heredocs) as they are instead of escaped JSON.

Refs #46
EOF
timeout 120 git push -q -u origin fix/46-log-safety 2>&1 | tail -1
timeout 120 gh pr create --title "fix: don't run workflow commands from tool output, and log only new requests" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
I checked the log of the first real run on the new code, [run 43188744510](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/actions/runs/43188744510) on #46. The new layout works: the `Setup` group, the `🤖` line, the `🧵 Thread` group at the top, `🔧`/`↳` per step, `✅ Replied … (16 model responses · 15 tool calls · 3m00s · 2.8M tokens in, 8k out)`, the `🧵 … is at b90c344` line at the end, and no push lines. The log also showed three problems, which this PR fixes:

1. **Tool output ran as workflow commands.** `npm run check` prints oxlint's `::error file=…::` lines. The `↳` group printed them as they were, so the runner created two **failure annotations** on that run (see its annotations). Text from pi and from tools now goes between `::stop-commands::<random token>` and `::<token>::` when it has a line that looks like a workflow command (`::…` or `##[…`). Other text is logged as before.
2. **Answered requests were logged again.** A run resubmits every trigger on the thread, so the run logged five `▶ Request` lines for comments that earlier runs had already answered. The line now comes from a new `started` option of `ThreadConversation`. It is called only when the submission has not settled yet.
3. **Arguments were escaped JSON.** A heredoc came out as `"command": "cat > /tmp/replay.ts <<'EOF'\nimport …"`. Arguments are now `key: value` lines, and a multi-line string (a script, a file) is shown as it is. The argument limit goes from 2,000 to 4,000 characters, so most scripts fit.

Tests: workflow command markers around output and text, multi-line arguments, and a later run that logs only its new request. Docs: `security.md`.

`npm run check` passes (385 tests).
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -1
